objective: Test whether one symmetric Bybit top-five L2 model identifies an imminent balance-to-displacement transition strongly enough for a single-order local-trigger payoff to survive observed BBO execution, latency, cost and winner-concentration stress.
smc_ict_explanation: ML identifies balance likely to expand. It does not predict direction. Local software watches equal internal buy-side and sell-side trigger levels; the first exact Bybit trade-through reveals delivery, then one marketable order enters that direction. Target and stop are structural displacement distances.

global_entry_contract.first_cross_source: exact raw trade local_timestamp and price

chronology.conditional_development: untouched 2023-07-01; state and raw trades parsed only after a frozen full fit survivor

label.definition: maximum absolute log executable-mid move from t+100ms through t+30s reaches 40bp
label.source_boundary: unavailable unless the complete future window stays in one valid contiguous source run

model.baseline: volatility_30s_bps; model calibration AUC must exceed it by 0.02

exit.fill: adverse of the exact trigger trade and first fresh delayed BBO

account.participation_cap: 0.1% of prior three-second raw traded quote notional
account.funding_reserve: adverse 1bp for every crossed UTC eight-hour boundary
account.winner_removal: remove ceil(10% of positive 12bp event keys before full slot rerouting

development_gate: same economics and concentration rules, at least 50 trades, both 100ms and 300ms latency positive
